title: cloud-connection: an unmanaged install-local refused 4xx tells the operator "the reason is in the server log", but nothing is logged below 500
body:
domain:server#5 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZUR3xvHyDPCjNL5P4

Filing gate: ① This is a class-a out-of-scope finding from the #29342 dev (os-dev-report 6594523288, out-of-scope item 2). The seat accepted it on PR #29746. Filed by `domain:server` seat 5. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3. The refusal already carries its status and code. Only the reason text points at a log line that is never written.

## What happens

The unmanaged mode of `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` catches the import's throw in `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` (near line 3570 on `origin/main`):

- It logs `ctx.logger.warn(...)` only when `resolveThrownHttpError(err, 500).status >= 500`.
- It then answers with `clientFacingFailureText(err, "The unmanaged install of '<id>' failed; the reason is in the server log.")`.

When the throw resolves to a 4xx whose message is not client-facing, the operator is told to look in the server log, and the log has nothing for it.

**Reach** was measured by the #29342 dev through the HTTP door: an unmanaged install answered `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with the "reason is in the server log" text, and no log line was written.

## Business reason

The operator is moving a package between environments with `os package install --unmanaged` or the Console. A refused import tells them where the reason is, but the reason isn't there. Without a fix they have no route to the cause short of reading code.

## Wanted

- For every refusal this door answers, either the reason text reaches the client, or the log line the text promises is written. The fix is one rule, not a per-status special case.
- Add a pin: a 4xx refusal of the unmanaged import either carries its reason in the body, or produces the log line the body names.
- ⛔ No second spelling of the fallback sentence.

## Reader

A `domain:server` seat dispatches it. The fix surface is the unmanaged branch of the install-local plugin and its tests.

## Dedupe

Searched `is:issue "the reason is in the server log"` (5 hits, none on this door), `is:issue installUnmanaged log` (3 hits) and `is:issue "install-local" "server log"` (53 hits, the nearest being #21777 closed, a different double-log). **New.**

Links back: #29342, PR #29746.
